screening_algorithm_raw: pulse oximetry in asymptomatic newborns; saturation <=95% after 24 h positive; positive screens received cardiac ultrasound
study_target_definition_raw: critical congenital cardiovascular malformation (CCVM); detected positive cases were TAPVR2 and truncus arteriosus1
individual_diagnoses: TAPVR x2; truncus arteriosus x1; one false-positive screen without diagnosis reported
lesion_mapping_status: TAPVR is conditional under the locked target and no <=28-day death/surgery/catheterization qualifier is reported; truncus arteriosus is off-list. Therefore no detected source-CCVM case is automatically removed: harmonized CCHD=0; denominator=4.
management_actionability_evidence: The three structural diagnoses are clinically important but the report does not provide participant-specific qualifying treatment/escalation/disposition/follow-up consequence -> CAN-U3. The single false-positive screen is not assigned healthy/no-diagnosis because the abstract does not report a terminal noncardiac diagnosis or global clinical outcome -> UNKNOWN1.
poolability_reason: exact final-positive denominator and structural diagnoses, but one of four harmonized-negative positives lacks terminal diagnosis/outcome classification; ascertainment 75%
source_full_text_provenance: Koppel RI et al. Pediatrics. 2003;111(3):451-455. PMID 12612220; DOI 10.1542/peds.111.3.451. Primary PubMed/AAP report independently reverified.
extraction_notes: Three source true positives are returned to the harmonized CCHD-negative denominator under the locked lesion/event target. Strict0/4; Expanded3/4; UNKNOWN1. No inference that a conventional false-positive label equals globally healthy.

site_program: Universitätsmedizin Mannheim and participating maternity services
screening_algorithm_raw: postductal SpO2; >=95% pass; 90-94% repeated after 4-6 h; initial <90% or persistent <95% prompted echocardiography
study_target_definition_raw: nine prenatally unrecognized congenital heart defects among 18 abnormal final screens; lesion identities not reported in accessible primary report
diagnosis_categories_raw: congenital heart defects; persistent fetal circulation; neonatal infection
diagnosis_counts_raw: CHD9; persistent fetal circulation2; neonatal infection7
individual_diagnoses: nine CHD not individually identified; persistent fetal circulation x2; neonatal infection x7
lesion_mapping_status: Because the nine source-CHD lesion identities and <=28-day qualifying events are not reported, any number0-9 could satisfy the locked target. Harmonized CCHD=0-9; denominator=9-18.
management_actionability_evidence: Persistent fetal circulation2 and neonatal infection7 are clinically relevant diagnoses but no participant-specific qualifying treatment/escalation/disposition/follow-up consequence is documented -> CAN-U9. Any source-CHD case that re-enters the harmonized-negative denominator is likewise clinically relevant but actionability-undemonstrated -> CAN-U. Thus Strict0 and Expanded equals denominator, 9-18/9-18.
poolability_reason: all 18 final positives have a diagnostic category, but lesion-level identity of the nine CHD cases is unavailable, preventing a single harmonized denominator/analysis weight
source_full_text_provenance: Tautz J et al. Klin Padiatr. 2010;222(5):291-295. PMID 20458668; DOI 10.1055/s-0030-1253391. Primary publisher abstract and reported screening table independently reverified.
extraction_notes: Printed flow reconciles exactly: 18 final abnormal screens = CHD9 + persistent fetal circulation2 + neonatal infection7. Strict remains0. Expanded proportion is 100% under every admissible target mapping, but denominator is bounded9-18.

site_program: four Yale-New Haven Health System hospitals, Connecticut
screening_population: live-born newborns eligible for differential pulse-ox screening after excluding pre-screen echocardiography and missed/refused screens
screening_algorithm_raw: differential preductal/postductal pulse oximetry using CCHD screening algorithm; positive screens underwent echocardiography
study_target_definition_raw: source CCHD definition; four positive pulse-ox screens had noncritical cardiac lesions and no CCHD was detected by POx alone
diagnosis_counts_raw: four positive POx screens; all four showed noncritical cardiac lesions by echocardiogram
individual_diagnoses: noncritical cardiac lesion x4; individual lesion names not reported in accessible primary report
lesion_mapping_status: The source explicitly characterizes all four screen-positive cardiac findings as noncritical and reports no CCHD identified by POx alone. Under the locked target these four remain in the harmonized CCHD-negative denominator: harmonized CCHD=0; denominator=4.
management_actionability_evidence: All four have clinically relevant structural cardiac findings, but no participant-specific qualifying treatment/escalation/disposition/follow-up consequence is reported -> CAN-U4. No case is promoted to Strict from diagnostic seriousness alone.
poolability_reason: exact final-positive denominator; all four harmonized-negative final positives are echocardiographically classified; 100% positive-outcome ascertainment. Incomplete one-year follow-up of negative screens does not reduce ascertainment of the final-positive denominator used for the CAN analysis.
source_full_text_provenance: Klausner R et al. Hosp Pediatr. 2017;7(4):214-218. PMID 28250095; PMCID PMC5924700; DOI 10.1542/hpeds.2016-0176. Primary PubMed/PMC report independently reverified.
extraction_notes: 10,320 screened and 10,316 negative screens imply four positive screens, explicitly confirmed in the report. Strict0/4; Expanded4/4. The reported 52.1% one-year retention applies to negative screens, not to the four screen-positive infants whose echocardiographic outcomes are fully reported.
